scenarios.request_text: We are building a Cold Email Campaign. Goal: let a user describe their offer, ICP, proof, and target segment, then have the agent create a campaign brief, research plan, first-touch email, follow-up sequence, deliverability checklist, and reply-handling plan. Review the proposed experience as both a cold-email outreach workflow and a UI/UX product workflow inside agentic chat. Identify the information the chat needs to collect, design the minimum useful workflow, point out UI/UX risks, suggest screens and states, define outputs at each step, include accessibility and usability issues, and identify what should be tested with users before building more.

acceptance_checks.description: Cover the required product and outreach deliverables.
Separate workflow design, interface states, risks, and validation plan.
Resolve citations used for current deliverability or accessibility claims.

scenarios.notes: A fan-out candidate: outreach constraints, product workflow, accessibility, and validation can be researched independently before synthesis.

scenarios.request_text: I have an iPhone. Can you research which app I should download for this?

terms: brain-training games improve all cognitive skills

acceptance_checks.description: Resolve the selected app's availability and measurement claims.

scenarios.notes: The canonical sequential case: librarian resolves 'this' from the snapshot, researcher compares current iPhone options, CEO recommends one.
